ground_truth_question: How do I retrieve personal data from my BCG laptop before leaving?
ground_truth_answer: To retrieve personal data, you must create a folder named “Personal Data” in your OneDrive and share the link with IT and your Line Manager (LM). That folder is strictly for your personal content and must not include any BCG or client files. Your Line Manager has to verify the contents in advance—specifically at least ten days before your Last Working Day. After your Line Manager’s review is complete, the Local IT team will deliver your personal data to your personal email via a secure OneDrive link on your Last Working Day.
